scope: Initial feature-level inventory of all 20 blueprint capabilities; not an exhaustive atomic requirement ledger or a production certification.

requirements.title: Durable incident workflow
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Atomic tenant-key admission; stable workflow ID; bounded retries; cancellation and old-history replay; independently measured crash recovery.
requirements.remaining_validation: Multi-host failover/replay campaigns, old-history compatibility, multi-host HA and failover campaigns

requirements.title: Resource reservation
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Monotonic reservation fence and atomic target-version refusal under races and failover.
requirements.remaining_validation: Real adapter-enforced fencing and failover/clock tests

requirements.title: Effect receipt gateway
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Durable effect identity and original-key reconciliation; independent postcondition; no blind duplicate.
requirements.remaining_validation: External effect acknowledgment/retention guarantees

requirements.title: Budgets and backpressure
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Bound admission, queues and cost; measure overload and latency under a declared workload.
requirements.remaining_validation: Preregistered production-like stepped/burst/blackout load campaigns, external model budgets, actual Temporal schedule-to-start p95/p99, multi-host SLO and failover evidence

requirements.title: Adaptive investigation
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Bounded investigation and runbook fallback; independently compare recovery and cost.
requirements.remaining_validation: Evaluated multi-probe model policy, empirical quality and token metrics

requirements.title: Tool policy gateway
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Read-only scoped tools, schema validation, denied capability and injection tests.
requirements.remaining_validation: Production capability grants, external connector permissions and adversarial load testing

requirements.title: Evidence provenance
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Versioned evidence provenance and freshness; independently attest sources and validate privacy.
requirements.remaining_validation: Signed external telemetry attestation, robust retention/redaction review

requirements.title: Safe abstention
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Abstain on invalid evidence; calibrate false confidence and refusal using held-out outcomes.
requirements.remaining_validation: Empirical calibration with independent held-out families; current 0/100 is **not a probability**

requirements.title: Operator workbench
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Accurate reconnecting UI, load and accessibility tests with real sessions.
requirements.remaining_validation: Real-provider browser sessions, multi-replica stream limits, reconnect/load campaigns and accessibility audit

requirements.title: Approval boundary
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Exact-version human approval, expiry/revocation and separation of authority.
requirements.remaining_validation: Spoken screen-reader approval acceptance is deferred to the UI redesign. External identity, independent release authority and two-person release evidence remain blocked.

requirements.title: Forensic graph
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Tenant-scoped complete causal lineage, cross-process traces and privacy review.
requirements.remaining_validation: Migration 0046 automatically projects new experience edges and passed exact-commit Linux CI. Assess whether incident membership needs persisted edges; bounded runtime recovery, other trace kinds, measured performance, collector-unavailable behavior and accessibility remain. Independent acceptance remains blocked.

requirements.title: Paired replay
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Time-sealed paired trials with equal budgets, hidden labels and independent oracle.
requirements.remaining_validation: Actual paired model-vs-runbook controlled trial, statistical inference

requirements.title: Experience capture
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Consent-epoch capsule capture, safe replay, retrieval denial and independently tested purge.
requirements.remaining_validation: Separate native experience projector with its own restricted PostgreSQL role, verified real DB column grants and outbox RLS, independent worker heartbeat/readiness, disjoint Temporal-vs-projection claims and crash-safe delivery, tests for denied effect/consent writes and nonblocking signals; **now uses** PostgreSQL RLS to hide Temporal outbox rows from the projector, a SECURITY DEFINER boolean ordering check, and column-limited source reads that deny evidence excerpts, origin identities and outcome reasons; **now also uses** intent-scoped PostgreSQL source-row RLS that hides unrelated and completed incidents; **still needs** per-tenant service compartmentalization and external security review, privacy/backups erasure evidence, source-versioned manifest, real-provider role and multi-host operations

requirements.title: Outcome adjudication
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Independent outcome revision, disagreement and delayed recovery adjudication.
requirements.remaining_validation: Independent real-world recovery oracle and delayed outcome reconciliation

requirements.title: Failure learning
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Fact-linked failure taxonomy and human-reviewed improvement proposals.
requirements.remaining_validation: Independent reviewers, causal attribution beyond typed simulator facts

requirements.title: Validated memory
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Versioned source-bound lessons with expiry, invalidation, consent and measured retrieval benefit.
requirements.remaining_validation: G4 requires independent held-out effectiveness evidence. Live activation remains subject to the existing release and production gates.

requirements.title: Evaluation
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Frozen paired candidate and incumbent evaluation, cost/safety controls and independent signatures.
requirements.remaining_validation: Independent hidden-label custody, real measured recovery-cost outcomes, preregistration and separate evaluator authority

requirements.title: Policy rollout
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Independently signed bundle, pinned exposure, authorized canary, pause and rollback; no promotion without gates.
requirements.remaining_validation: **Live rollout disabled** pending independent real E5 PASS, signed bundle, separate release authority and rollback certification

requirements.title: Strategy routing
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Approved bounded route choice, no-memory fallback and measured comparative benefit.
requirements.remaining_validation: Evaluated contextual policies, measured route accuracy, memory/agent variants

requirements.title: Adapter conformance
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Real authorized provider conformance, crash/fencing/retention evidence and independent review.
requirements.remaining_validation: Real named provider/target conformance and fault-injection/retention campaign, independent traces and verified security/release authority
